item.text:
**Bottom line**
- 2024 is a mixed but meaningfully implementation-heavy record. Tinubu did convert some agenda items into budget controls, new delivery institutions, cash transfers, a student-loan law, procurement reorganization, and crisis-response programs. But a large part of the state’s visible reach in 2024 was coercive, especially around protests and journalism, so the year does not read as slogan-only, but neither does it show clean, rights-respecting implementation across the board.

**Accepted claims**
- Positive | [President Tinubu Signs 2024 of Renewed Hope, Directs MDAs to Provide Monthly Performance Reports](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-signs-2024-of-renewed-hope-directs-mdas-to-provide-monthly-performance-reports/) | State House, Abuja | 2024-01-01 | Claim: Tinubu tied the 2024 budget to monthly performance reports, regular EMT review, and monitored implementation, which is concrete evidence of turning priorities into administrative process. | IDs: 8B.6
- Positive | [President Tinubu Directs Expeditious Processing of Welfare Benefits, Demands Monthly KPI Reports](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-expeditious-processing-of-welfare-benefits-demands-monthly-kpi-reports/) | State House, Abuja | 2024-02-22 | Claim: He ordered faster handling of welfare benefits and KPI reporting, showing a real effort to make social support operational rather than rhetorical. | IDs: 8B.6
- Positive | [President Tinubu Establishes Comprehensive Economic Coordination and Planning System for Nigeria](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/) | State House, Abuja | 2024-03-27 | Claim: Tinubu created the PECC and EET, explicitly mandating rapid implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of economic interventions. | IDs: 8B.6
- Positive | [In Detail: The Student Loan (Access to Higher Education) Act, 2024](https://statehouse.gov.ng/in-detail-the-student-loan-access-to-higher-education-act-2024/) | State House, Abuja | 2024-04-04 | Claim: The student-loan pledge became a signed law and a standing delivery structure via NELFUND, with eligibility and nationwide-spread provisions. | IDs: 8B.6
- Positive | [Nigeria restarts cash transfers to cushion hardship caused by reforms](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-restarts-cash-transfers-to-cushion-hardship-caused-by-reforms-46031196/) | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-02-26 | Claim: The government approved immediate resumption of cash transfers to 12 million vulnerable households, which is observable state reach, not just announcement. | IDs: 8B.6
- Positive | [President Tinubu Directs Reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/) | State House, Abuja | 2024-06-15 | Claim: Tinubu used executive authority to reorder procurement administration for efficiency and transparency, which is concrete institutional action. | IDs: 8B.6
- Positive | [President Tinubu Launches National Resettlement Scheme for Conflict Victims](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-national-resettlement-scheme-for-conflict-victims/) | State House, Abuja | 2024-07-06 | Claim: He launched a resettlement program for conflict victims, showing a programmatic response to displacement rather than symbolic empathy only. | IDs: 8B.6
- Negative | [Nigerian Government Warnings Raise Concerns about Upcoming Protests](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/29/nigerian-government-warnings-raise-concerns-about-upcoming-protests) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-29 | Claim: Senior officials and security agencies framed planned protests as a threat, which signals readiness to stifle dissent rather than convert reform language into open civic space. | IDs: 8B.6
- Negative | [Nigeria security forces deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom](https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-31 | Claim: The government said it was open to dialogue, but security forces simultaneously deployed in major cities, making the implementation picture mixed and coercive. | IDs: 8B.6
- Negative | [Nigeria: Protesters Charged with Treason](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-09-06 | Claim: Authorities charged protesters with treason and held many, including children, in prolonged detention, showing hard state reach used against dissent. | IDs: 8B.6
- Negative | [Nigeria: Bloody August: Nigerian government’s violent crackdown on #EndBadGovernance protests](https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr44/8780/2024/en/) | Amnesty International | 2024-11-28 | Claim: Amnesty documented harassment before, during, and after the protests, including killings and mass detentions, which is strong evidence of coercive implementation rather than slogan-to-service delivery. | IDs: 8B.6
- Negative | [Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown](https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown) | Reuters via GPB | 2024-05-09 | Claim: Detaining an investigative journalist under cybercrime law shows the state using enforcement capacity to suppress scrutiny, not just to implement public policy. | IDs: 8B.6

**Search gap**
- I found strong evidence of implementation mechanics in fiscal management, social transfers, education finance, procurement, and conflict resettlement.
- I did not find a clean independent 2024 audit showing that these reforms were fully and evenly implemented nationwide or that they had durable end-year outcomes.
- So the record supports “more than slogans,” but mostly at the level of rollout and administrative architecture, not completed, widely visible success.
